reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26088256 on 2026-09-30, asset() on tracked sAID 0xb3b3c527ba57cd61648e2ec2f5e006a0b390a9f8 returned tracked AID 0x18f52b3fb465118731d9e0d276d4eb3599d57596, matching GAIB's deployment registry. The serial lineage is retained as a strategy-vault claim under owner decision D3, not as a statement that the vault holds 100% idle AID. AI financing, custody, liquidity and counterparty risk remain explicit. The product-specific memorandum recovered on 2026-10-01 identifies SpiceFlow AI Corporation as the operator and Good AI SPC as the Cayman segregated portfolio company through which strategies execute. Page 5 states that tokens confer no direct redemption of vault contents, voting or equity rights, and that redemption rights are not a demand-deposit or repayable debt obligation of any sAID Group entity. This documents the holder-right limitations without establishing a security interest, bankruptcy remoteness, named reserve custodians or their allocations.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact Ethereum sAID asset() read at block 26088256 and issuer deployment registry
